convert correlated subqueries to IN clauses
use CTEs with MATERIALIZE clause to precompute filtered keys
reached_sql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sales_grouped.cnt), 0)::bigint AS count
FROM (
    SELECT ss_sold_time_sk, ss_hdemo_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_store_sk IN (
        SELECT s_store_sk
        FROM store
        WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
    )
    GROUP BY ss_sold_time_sk, ss_hdemo_sk
) AS sales_grouped
JOIN (
    SELECT t_time_sk
    FROM time_dim
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
) AS time_keys ON sales_grouped.ss_sold_time_sk = time_keys.t_time_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
) AS household_keys ON sales_grouped.ss_hdemo_sk = household_keys.hd_demo_sk
ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 100
